_comment: Run the DbspNet engine (a .NET DBSP implementation) head-to-head with Feldera,
the closest engine class (streaming IVM / DBSP). SF=3 smoke shape.
No prerequisite beyond Docker: the dbspnet-server image is built from source, cloning
clast-project/dbsp-net at a pinned commit (override the DBSPNET_COMMIT build arg to bump).
